Name: GoodTrip
Author: khalil886
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Adds a small GoodTrip-style fast-travel map to Stardew Valley.

Hold [b]Tab[/b] to open the map, choose a Pelican Town overworld destination with the arrow keys or mouse, then release [b]Tab[/b] to teleport. You can also click a destination while holding [b]Tab[/b] to teleport immediately.

The map uses a short opening animation and an animated selection indicator. Farm travel defaults to the farmhouse entrance, while other destinations use a safe tile near the center of the area.[/color]


[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]
为星露谷物语添加了一个仿 GoodTrip 风格的小型快速旅行地图。

按住 [b]Tab[/b] 打开地图后，可以使用方向键或鼠标选择鹈鹕镇地表区域，松开 [b]Tab[/b] 即可传送。按住 [b]Tab[/b] 时直接点击区域方块，也可以立即传送。

地图包含简短的打开动画和选中提示动画。传送到农场时默认前往农舍门口，其他地区默认寻找靠近地图中央的安全落点。[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Requirements first:[/b] Stardew Valley 1.6.x and SMAPI 4.x.[/color]


[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] if you have not already.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Unzip the downloaded archive so that you get this folder:[/color]
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/GoodTrip/[/code][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI ([b]StardewModdingAPI.exe[/b], or via Steam if you set it up that way).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Load a save and hold [b]Tab[/b] to open the GoodTrip map.[/color][/*]
[/list]

[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[b]前置要求：[/b]星露谷物语 1.6.x 和 SMAPI 4.x。[/color]


[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]安装 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]（如果还没有安装）。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]解压下载的压缩包，确保目录结构为：[/color]
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/GoodTrip/[/code][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]通过 SMAPI 启动游戏（[b]StardewModdingAPI.exe[/b]，或使用你设置好的 Steam 启动方式）。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]进入存档后按住 [b]Tab[/b]，即可打开 GoodTrip 地图。[/color][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]GoodTrip-style map.[/b] Hold [b]Tab[/b] to open a compact destination map with an animated selector.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Keyboard navigation.[/b] Use the arrow keys to move between available destinations.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Mouse selection.[/b] Move the cursor over a room to select it, then click while holding [b]Tab[/b] to teleport.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Tab release teleport.[/b] Release [b]Tab[/b] to teleport to the selected area.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Farmhouse entrance landing.[/b] Farm travel targets the farmhouse entrance by default.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Safe central landing.[/b] Other areas use a safe tile near the center when no custom point has been saved.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Custom landing points.[/b] Stand where you want to arrive, open the map, and press [b]R[/b] to save the current tile for that area.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Clear saved points.[/b] Press [b]Delete[/b] while the map is open to remove the current area's saved point.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Vanilla Tab behavior preserved.[/b] A short Tab press still opens the normal inventory; the map only appears when Tab is held.[/color][/*]
[/list]

[line]


[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]仿 GoodTrip 地图。[/b]按住 [b]Tab[/b] 打开带有选中动画的小型地区地图。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]方向键选择。[/b]使用上下左右在可用地区之间移动选中项。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]鼠标选择。[/b]鼠标移动到房间方块上即可选中，按住 [b]Tab[/b] 点击方块即可传送。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]松开 Tab 传送。[/b]松开 [b]Tab[/b] 后传送到当前选中的地区。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]农场落点。[/b]传送到农场时默认前往农舍门口。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]中央安全落点。[/b]其他地区没有自定义落点时，会在靠近地图中央的位置寻找安全格子。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]自定义落点。[/b]站在想要到达的位置，打开地图并按 [b]R[/b]，即可记录当前地区的落点。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]清除落点。[/b]打开地图后按 [b]Delete[/b]，即可删除当前地区的自定义落点。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]保留原版 Tab 操作。[/b]短按 Tab 仍然打开原版物品栏，只有长按 Tab 才会显示地图。[/color][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Controls and custom landing points [/b][/size]
[b]Controls:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Short press Tab:[/b] open the vanilla inventory.[/*]
[*][b]Hold Tab:[/b] open the GoodTrip map.[/*]
[*][b]Arrow keys:[/b] change the selected destination.[/*]
[*][b]Mouse hover:[/b] select the room under the cursor.[/*]
[*][b]Mouse left click while holding Tab:[/b] teleport to the clicked room.[/*]
[*][b]Release Tab:[/b] teleport to the selected room.[/*]
[*][b]R while the map is open:[/b] save the current tile as the landing point for the current area.[/*]
[*][b]Delete while the map is open:[/b] clear the saved landing point for the current area.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Saving a landing point:[/b]

Stand on the tile where you want to arrive in an overworld area. Hold [b]Tab[/b] to open the map, then press [b]R[/b]. The point is stored in the save data for that save file.

If a saved tile becomes blocked or invalid, GoodTrip automatically falls back to a safe default tile.

[line]

[b]操作：[/b]
[list]
[*][b]短按 Tab：[/b]打开原版物品栏。[/*]
[*][b]按住 Tab：[/b]打开 GoodTrip 地图。[/*]
[*][b]方向键：[/b]切换选中地区。[/*]
[*][b]鼠标悬停：[/b]选中鼠标所在的房间方块。[/*]
[*][b]按住 Tab 点击鼠标左键：[/b]传送到点击的房间。[/*]
[*][b]松开 Tab：[/b]传送到当前选中房间。[/*]
[*][b]地图打开时按 R：[/b]将当前地区的当前位置保存为落点。[/*]
[*][b]地图打开时按 Delete：[/b]清除当前地区的自定义落点。[/*]
[/list]
[b]保存落点：[/b]

在地表地区站到想要到达的格子上，按住 [b]Tab[/b] 打开地图，然后按 [b]R[/b]。落点会保存到当前存档的数据中。

如果保存的格子后来变得不可通行或不再有效，GoodTrip 会自动改用安全的默认落点。

[*][color=#D4D4D8]Teleporting is blocked while an event, minigame, incompatible menu state, or other movement-blocking state is active.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]The current release includes Summit, Railroad, Backwoods, Tunnel, Mountain, Farm, Bus Stop, Town, Calico Desert, Secret Woods, Forest, and Beach.[/color][/*]
[/list]
